description: Extract Complete Opal ledger, allocations and reset facts from the genuine active character and paired save.
target: Complete Opal ledger, allocations and reset facts

extractions.label: active_context
extractions.expression: ({ playerId: idleon.getAttr("GetPlayersUsernames").indexOf(idleon.getAttr("UserInfo")[0]), playerName: idleon.getAttr('UserInfo')[0], playerNames: idleon.getAttr('GetPlayersUsernames'), version: idleon.getAttr('DoOnceREAL') })
extractions.description: Capture real active character identity and version; do not switch or synthesize a context.

extractions.label: paired_hole_inputs
extractions.expression: ({ levels: idleon.getAttr("Holes")[1].slice(0,5), exp: idleon.getAttr("Holes")[2].slice(0,5), investments: idleon.getAttr("Holes")[3].slice(0,8), purchased: idleon.getAttr("Holes")[23].slice(0,5), studyLevels: idleon.getAttr("Holes")[26].slice(0,18), studyProgress: idleon.getAttr("Holes")[27].slice(0,18), target: idleon.getAttr("Holes")[11][61], cavernOpals: idleon.getAttr("Holes")[7], lanternUses: idleon.getAttr("Holes")[11][84], wishes: idleon.getAttr("Holes")[11][25], layers: [idleon.getAttr("Holes")[11][1],idleon.getAttr("Holes")[11][3],idleon.getAttr("Holes")[11][5],idleon.getAttr("Holes")[11][7]], covePurchases: idleon.getAttr('OptionsListAccount')[604] })
extractions.description: Saved inputs directly used by part 1; runtime counter mismatches remain failures.

extractions.label: external_total
extractions.description: Exact refresh subtotal, including floor of Emperor plus schematic.

extractions.label: emperor_schematic_floor_adjustment
extractions.description: Joint floor adjustment relative to raw Emperor and schematic contributions.

extractions.label: external_rounding_adjustment
extractions.expression: Math.round(Number(idleon.getAttr("GemItemsPurchased")[5]) + idleon.callFunction("Summoning", "GrimoireUpgBonus", 11, 0) + (25 * idleon.callFunction("Companions", 13) + (idleon.callFunction("Windwalker", "CompassBonus", 52, 0) + (Math.floor(idleon.callFunction("Thingies", "EmperorBon", 3, 0) + idleon.callFunction("Holes", "B_UPG", 102, 1)) + (idleon.callFunction("ArcaneType", "ArcaneUpgBonus", 25, 0) + idleon.callFunction("SushiStuff", "RoG_BonusQTY", 56, 0)))))) - (Number(idleon.getAttr("GemItemsPurchased")[5]) + idleon.callFunction("Summoning", "GrimoireUpgBonus", 11, 0) + (25 * idleon.callFunction("Companions", 13) + (idleon.callFunction("Windwalker", "CompassBonus", 52, 0) + (Math.floor(idleon.callFunction("Thingies", "EmperorBon", 3, 0) + idleon.callFunction("Holes", "B_UPG", 102, 1)) + (idleon.callFunction("ArcaneType", "ArcaneUpgBonus", 25, 0) + idleon.callFunction("SushiStuff", "RoG_BonusQTY", 56, 0))))))
extractions.description: Final refresh rounding after Emperor and schematic contributions are floored together.

extractions.label: cavern_total
extractions.description: All saved cavern rows as credited by refresh caller.

extractions.label: earned
extractions.description: Exact fresh earned balance; never cached actor balance.

extractions.label: invested
extractions.description: All eight investment slots subtracted by original refresh.

extractions.label: uninvested
extractions.expression: (() => { let balance=Math.round(Number(idleon.getAttr("GemItemsPurchased")[5]) + idleon.callFunction("Summoning", "GrimoireUpgBonus", 11, 0) + (25 * idleon.callFunction("Companions", 13) + (idleon.callFunction("Windwalker", "CompassBonus", 52, 0) + (Math.floor(idleon.callFunction("Thingies", "EmperorBon", 3, 0) + idleon.callFunction("Holes", "B_UPG", 102, 1)) + (idleon.callFunction("ArcaneType", "ArcaneUpgBonus", 25, 0) + idleon.callFunction("SushiStuff", "RoG_BonusQTY", 56, 0)))))); for(const value of idleon.getAttr("Holes")[7]) balance=Math.round(balance+Number(value)); for(const value of idleon.getAttr("Holes")[3].slice(0,8)) balance=Math.round(balance-Number(value)); return balance; })()
extractions.description: Exact original refresh computation, without invoking reset or changing actor cache.
